notes:
Dialogs no longer disappear behind the page.

**The app was not freezing.** Opening the bookmarks list — or the hymn keypad, a book's contents, the tab menu, rename, or close-all-tabs — while you were annotating could leave the screen stuck on the last thing it drew. Switching apps or going Home and back brought it right back, because nothing was actually wrong with the app: the dialog had opened, but the page was still holding the screen, so the dialog was never drawn.

Every dialog in the reader now hands the screen back before it opens, including the ones that open on top of another dialog, like adding a bookmark from the bookmarks list or renaming from the tab menu.

Nothing you had written was ever at risk — the ink was already saved before the screen stopped updating.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
